title: CAM Assist Revision Lineage Schema
description: Portable, package-scoped record of how a package's manufacturing reasoning evolved across revisions, expressed as an ordered supersession chain. A sidecar artifact that travels alongside a strategy package without mutating it. Informational only: it is a narrative chain of human-declared revision checkpoints, NOT artifact version control. It does not retain historical artifact versions, grant execution authority, enforce approval authority, or authorize machine execution.

record_version.description: Semantic version of the revision lineage record FORMAT. Not a content-revision counter.

package_reference.description: Reference to the package whose reasoning this lineage tracks. Accepts federated_package_id, relative path, or package directory name.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this lineage record was created

revisions.description: Ordered chain of human-declared revision checkpoints for the package's manufacturing reasoning. Each entry may supersede a prior entry. Informational only.

revision_id.description: Human label for this revision, unique within the file (e.g., 'rev-1', 'A')

summary.description: Human-readable description of what changed in this revision

supersedes.description: Optional revision_id of the prior revision this one replaces. Absent means this is a root. Must reference an existing revision_id; self-reference and cycles are invalid.

revised_by.description: Optional informational identifier of who made the revision. No trust validation performed.

related_records.description: Optional pointers to the traceability sidecars associated with this revision. Referenced, never mutated. Pointers do not guarantee retention of a file's historical state.

assumptions_file.description: Optional reference to a manufacturing assumptions sidecar associated with this revision.

risk_file.description: Optional reference to a risk assessment sidecar associated with this revision.

decision_record_file.description: Optional reference to a manufacturing decision record sidecar associated with this revision.

authority.description: Informational authority constraints. When present, every flag MUST be true.

is_informational.description: MUST be true. This record is informational only.

does_not_authorize_execution.description: MUST be true. This record does not authorize machine execution.

does_not_bypass_human_review.description: MUST be true. This record does not bypass required human review.
